Home - Marilyn Strickland Skip to content Washington’s South Sound: Supporting small businesses, protecting the Puget Sound, delivering for servicemembers, veterans, families, and fighting for reproductive freedom. Servicemembers and Military Families: Improving the quality-of-life for our servicemembers and their families. Working Families: Delivering for seniors, veterans, servicemembers, and families. Transportation Improvements: Investing in infrastructure by delivering federal funds to the South Sound. Reproductive Freedom: Fighting for abortion rights and advocating for reproductive health and justice.
